text: Martingrove Baseball Inc. is a grassroots all-volunteer community-based organization featuring all levels of co-ed baseball and girls' softball since 1958. This seasonal permit holder provides opportunity for Etobicoke residents to participate in baseball/softball. The changes being proposed at Jim Horton diamond at Martingrove Gardens Park include moving the infield back 10 to 20 feet and angling it a few degrees to avoid the trees that currently impact left field. The fencing will be upgraded to more suitable fencing for the level of play on this diamond. The proposed changes have been reviewed and approved in principle by Parks staff. The City, through Parks and Recreation’s Capital Rehabilitation Program, already has the following work to be completed at this site: replacing players benches, bleachers and removing of the current backstop.
